title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode7 Memories of Junior High

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, that should do it.
This is more or less how most drum kits are set up.

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line: You need four cymbals...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Drummers will change that depending on the song or their personal style.

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line: S-Sorry, is there anything else that I should know?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... Oh, you'll want to know how to tune them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to hear for myself, so would it be alright if I played for a second...?

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line: Yes, of course!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It's been so long...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I think I still remember how to play the song we did all those years ago...)

rows.Speaker: First-Year B
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a great teacher, Mochizuki! I feel much more confident now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Please let me know if you have any further questions.

rows.Speaker: First-Year B
rows.Line:
You looked so cool playing just now!
Did you use to be in a band or something?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Umm... For a little bit during elementary school. Oh, I also used to be a percussionist for the brass band.

rows.Speaker: First-Year B
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line:
Again, you were a lifesaver.
I really can't thank you enough for what you did today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Of course. Good luck during the school festival.

rows.Speaker: First-Year A
rows.Line:
Thank you!
Why don't we go turn in our application right now?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line: Yeah, let's go!
se_walk_women_002_4

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was the first time I played the drums in such a long time...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My hands and feet... No, my entire body still remembered what to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Including how to play that song.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I did join the brass band and keep practicing in secret after we called it quits. That may be why.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I just remember how much fun I had while playing music as a group...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wanted to become a better drummer and be the one to say, “Let's get our band back together.”)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I kept practicing because I believed that day would come...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Unfortunately...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Saki
rows.Line: Have you all decided which clubs you're gonna join?

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: I'll be continuing with brass band.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not joining one.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika
rows.Line: I might not join one either...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, but the choices are endless.
Not joining a club seems like a huge waste.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, Saki, you said you'd join a club once you were in junior high school, right? Do you know which one you're going to join?

rows.Speaker: Junior High Shiho
rows.Line: My guess is the home ec club. You get to have lots of snacks, right?

rows.Speaker: Junior High Saki
rows.Line:
No!
Drumroll, please...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Saki
rows.Line: I'm gonna join the soft tennis club!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Junior High Shiho
rows.Line: Are you serious? How are you gonna get through practice?

rows.Speaker: Junior High Saki
rows.Line: I'll be fine! The junior high and high school soft tennis clubs here are both supposed to be really laid-back.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Saki
rows.Line: I want to build my stamina up to the point that I don't have to take days off from school.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Saki
rows.Line: Then, we should be able to hang out a lot more than before♪

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: Did you hear, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: For the very first time, Saki managed to keep up with everyone else in the club when they ran during practice yesterday. Also, she didn't make a single mistake while practicing serves.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, I heard.
I'm guessing she's probably telling Shiho right now.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: She did seem really happy.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: But it's also amazing...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: When she first joined the soft tennis club, she had trouble doing half a lap around the schoolyard.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika
rows.Line: The three of us even wondered if she'd be okay staying in the club.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika
rows.Line: No matter how hard things get, Saki always seems to have a lot of fun...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: She always had to sit off to the side during gym class in elementary school, so getting to move her body like this must be exhilarating for her.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Her eyes always twinkle whenever she talks about club stuff.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Ichika
rows.Line: I'm so glad that she's always smiling and laughing now.

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: Me too...

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: (It's really nice to see her enjoying club activities like this.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: (She's apparently even been staying late all by herself to work on her fundamentals recently.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: (She really must love getting to be in a club.)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: (I've also become a much better drummer since entering junior high school, so I thought we could try playing together again...)

rows.Speaker: Junior High Honami
rows.Line: (But I suppose that can wait a little longer.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ultimately, I wasn't able to ask whether or not we could get our band back together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (On the other hand, Saki's newfound stamina allowed the four of us to create some wonderful memories.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We were all in the same class during our first year, which allowed us to work together for both the sports festival and the school festival.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika and Shiho were put in different classes during our second year...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I did enjoy being teammates with Saki during the multi-class relay for the sports festival.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (During our third year, Saki and I had to race against each other as the anchors for our respective classes. And she won by a nose.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I remember my classmates and I feeling so frustrated that time.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, for the choir recital, we decided as a class that we'd outperform Saki's.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But the school trip is the source of our most precious memories...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was so happy when I realized that Saki would finally get to go with us.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We had the second day to ourselves, so the four of us decided to see as many sights as we could. We even took quite a lot of pictures together.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (All three years of junior high school were really fun...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was hoping that we'd spend just as much time together in high school...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If this is the last time we're going to see each other on a regular basis...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'd like to create one last memory with them.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Am I the only one who feels this way...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I mean, the others are all so busy, and so am I.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So it probably won't be possible...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
It's okay...
We don't have to get our band back together to make memories.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As long as we get to enjoy the school festival together, I'll be...
But it sounds like you already know what you want to do, Honami.
Why don't you just tell her that?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Did I imagine that just now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wait...
I was going to return to class and help the others get ready for the school festival.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But they may've all gone home.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A notification? Oh, it's from that news app...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's right...
It's almost that time of year.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope the skies are clear when the Leonid meteor shower appears.
